results.title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine
results.overview: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.

results.title: Daydream
results.overview: On his first day of retirement, Leo faints on his way to his best friend's funeral. When he regains consciousness, he resumes his journey to the cemetery, where he experiences a strange and sublime personal catharsis.

results.title: DRUNK
results.overview: Haruna (25), who shows signs of alcohol dependency, spends her days drinking and having fun every night. But she repeatedly causes trouble for her friends and ends up apologizing to them again and again.  One day, Haruna loses her job and even starts bragging about it to her friends.  Gradually, her friends begin to distance themselves from her…

results.title: The Galley
results.overview: After being made redundant from her job at the coastal arcades, Helen commits a victimless crime to pay for dinner.

results.title: Siesta
results.overview: Conchita, a young woman unable to escape her constant exhaustion, embarks on a journey between dream and reality through a deserted Granada to confront herself and finish the Cruz de Mayo in time for the festivities.

results.title: Homebodies
results.overview: In a near future where it literally costs money to leave the house, a burnt-out woman risks fraud when she pays her live-in boyfriend's 'exit toll' to get some alone time.

results.title: To Die to Live
results.overview: In 2014, Shakhta, Dancer, and Potter volunteered for the army in order to fight in the Russo-Ukrainian conflict in eastern Ukraine. Although the horrible things they experienced during two years on the front accompany them for every second of their existence, they try to return to civilian life. But the Russian invasion in 2022 forces them to again confront the war.

results.title: Colonna, a Corsican tragedy
results.overview: Through the story of an underground militant in the armed struggle, the miniseries recounts 60 years of misunderstandings between Corsica and Paris through the voices of the story’s protagonists.

results.title: The Two Hornets
results.overview: Samo, a gay man facing an unplanned pregnancy with a woman overseas, reunites with his narcissistic mother at a remote forest cabin to confront their toxic past. Amidst a drug-fueled sexual affair with his former childhood bully, he struggles to decide if he should embrace fatherhood or break the cycle of inherited family sin. In Samo's warped reality, omnipresent hornets gain an evil power, forcing him to confront his mother with fire and an axe to extract the brutal truth of their relationship.

results.title: Na Bola Kotha
results.overview: A newly married couple’s life spirals into chaos when the bride suddenly refuses to stay with her husband just a day after their wedding.

results.title: The Nymph
results.overview: To help his beloved, the water nymph Ilo uses magic, but at a great cost: with every spell, his home, the forest lake, dies a little more.

results.title: Olhos, Olhos, Nariz, Boca
results.overview: One summer night, a teenage girl sneaks out of her house to meet a boy at a party. However, when she finds him, he is strange and distant. That same night and at that same party, a boy is intercepted by an unknown girl, who claims to know him.

results.title: In Transit
results.overview: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

results.title: Amalgam
results.overview: Helen is a visual artist who isolates herself in a house to prepare for a new artistic project. Her solitude is disrupted when her wife, Angela, returns from a trip. However, Helen begins to experience hallucinations and growing paranoia, leading her to question whether the woman in her house is truly Angela or an imposter.

results.title: Becoming Zendaya
results.overview: From Oakland dance classes to Emmy wins and box-office records, Zendaya's journey to Hollywood icon status through strategic choices, boundary-setting, and creative ambition—from Disney Channel star to producer and power player.

results.title: Mindflip
results.overview: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

results.title: Lux
results.overview: Projectors, films and light fixtures comprise a system subjected to repetition, wear and continuous observation. In Lux, light is treated as matter, index and vestige of the cinematographic device itself. The investigation remains open, rejecting any definitive diagnosis.

results.title: Silver Sadia
results.overview: A teenage girl secretly earns money through online gaming and YouTube with her mother’s support, but when the income starts appearing in her unsuspecting father’s bank account, he becomes determined to uncover the mystery behind it.

results.title: Life Beyond IV: PANSPERMIA
results.overview: Life on Earth could be descended from space-faring microbes from Mars — or even further beyond, riding here on an interplanetary highway of asteroids. Extremophile bacteria may be resilient enough to survive the intense 3-stage journey, by repairing their own damaged DNA or hibernating for the long, deadly journey through space.  The chemistry of life could even be spreading across star-systems to other parts of the galaxy, connecting biologies together in a huge web of life. Could we be part of an ancient cosmic family-tree? What other creatures could this tree contain?
